Upstream metacell geometry uses fixed projection and manual three-cell within-donor groups; original statistics execute.
No numerical substitutes in fold graph aggregation/reconstruction.

scope_limit: Native single_cell_graph.run consumes matching explicit donor/static preparations and completed canonical metacell receipts. The original fold graph producer now reaggregates canonical cells with frozen memberships, verifies per-group donor/context/count identities, and produces actual matrices, UCell activities, LASSO source/query masks, context scopes and target/static bindings. A dedicated read-only metacell completion validator cannot fall back to geometry fitting. All active fold graphs and static outputs are reconstructed from mapped measurements and frozen memberships. Original cached graph and query-episode consumers enforce the preparation proof, rejecting repinned matrix, activity and LASSO-mask corruption. The synthetic positive chain uses actual H5 mapping/static/donor production and original outer statistics, with only upstream geometry replaced by fixed projection and manual within-donor groups. The graph stage has no numerical substitutes. Original query assembly loads all five folds and computes source features before an explicit test boundary replaces episode fitting/serialization. This does not independently validate fitted geometry, original target statistics, biological donors or complete LASSO/episode ancestry. C01/C13/C16 remain open.
